meta.branch_note: branch rows cover the tape's top-400 booking branches (no-PII floor n>=30); smaller branches are suppressed.
meta.occ_note: occupation split is the BOOK mix per geo region (tape cross); the workforce side is NSO LFS employed + informal share — NSO publishes no per-region occupation census we can join yet.
